subject: Fix reply schemas validator build issue due to new regular expression (#13103)
reason: The change only modifies utils/generate-command-code.py, a build-time code generator used for the reply-schemas validator CI build. It escapes backslash and plus characters in generated C identifiers and uses json.dumps for string literals so the generated code compiles when a reply schema contains a regular expression. It is a build/CI fix with no change to server behavior, command replies, replication, persistence, or any runtime path a fuzzer scenario could reach; correctness is verified by the build itself compiling.
